arxiv-2101-02823.title: Practical Limits of Error Correction for Quantum Metrology
arxiv-2101-02823.creator: Nathan Shettell, William J. Munro, Damian Markham, Kae Nemoto
arxiv-2101-02823.description: Abstract Noise is the greatest obstacle in quantum metrology that limits it achievable precision and sensitivity. There are many techniques to mitigate the effect of noise, but this can never be done completely. One commonly proposed technique is to repeatedly apply quantum error correction.

arxiv-2104-07511.title: Ensemble of MRR and NDCG models for Visual Dialog
arxiv-2104-07511.creator: Idan Schwartz
arxiv-2104-07511.description: Abstract Assessing an AI agent that can converse in human language and understand visual content is challenging. Generation metrics, such as BLEU scores favor correct syntax over semantics. Hence a discriminative approach is often used, where an agent ranks a set of candidate options.

arxiv-2109-03244.title: Muonic Boson Limits: Supernova Redux
arxiv-2109-03244.creator: Andrea Caputo, Georg Raffelt, Edoardo Vitagliano
arxiv-2109-03244.description: Abstract We derive supernova (SN) bounds on muon-philic bosons, taking advantage of the recent emergence of muonic SN models. Our main innovations are to consider scalars ϕ \phi in addition to pseudoscalars a a and to include systematically the generic two-photon coupling G γ ​ γ G_{\gamma\gamma} implied by a muon triangle loop.

arxiv-2112-05538.title: First Lattice QCD Study of Proton Twist-3 GPDs
arxiv-2112-05538.creator: F. Steffens
arxiv-2112-05538.description: Abstract We present first results on selected twist-3 quark GPDs using the quasi-distribution method. This approach relates lattice QCD data and light-cone distribution functions using Large Momentum Effective Theory (LaMET). We calculate quark-antiquark correlators of boosted nucleons coupled to non-local operators with vector and axial Dirac structure, which is transverse to the momentum boost.

arxiv-2205-06316.title: Continuity in right semitopological groups
arxiv-2205-06316.creator: Evgenii Reznichenko
arxiv-2205-06316.description: Abstract Groups with a topology that is in consistent one way or another with the algebraic structure are considered. Classical groups with a topology are topological, paratopological, semitopological, and quasitopological groups. We also study other ways of matching topology and algebraic structure.

arxiv-2307-06661.title: The study of hadronic rescattering on K ∗ 0 K^{*0} resonance yield in baryon-rich QCD matter
arxiv-2307-06661.creator: Md Nasim
arxiv-2307-06661.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Md Nasim. The effect of hadronic rescattering on K ∗ 0 K^{*0} resonance yield can be studied by measuring K ∗ 0 / K K^{*0}/K ratio as a function of centrality or multiplicity. This study investigates how the size of the system and the chemical composition (meson-meson versus meson-baryon interaction) of the matter formed in heavy-ion collisions impact the process of hadronic rescattering.

arxiv-2307-08937.title: Photonic chip-based low noise microwave oscillator
arxiv-2307-08937.creator: Igor Kudelin, William Groman, Qing-Xin Ji, Joel Guo, Megan L. Kelleher, Dahyeon Lee, Takuma Nakamura, Charles A. McLemore, Pedram Shirmohammadi, Samin Hanifi, Haotian Cheng, Naijun Jin, Sam Halliday, Zhaowei Dai, Lue Wu, Warren Jin, Yifan Liu, Wei Zhang, Chao Xiang, Vladimir Iltchenko, Owen Miller,
arxiv-2307-08937.description: Abstract Numerous modern technologies are reliant on the low-phase noise and exquisite timing stability of microwave signals. Substantial progress has been made in the field of microwave photonics, whereby low noise microwave signals are generated by the down-conversion of ultra-stable optical references using a frequency comb.

arxiv-2404-01196.title: Estimating Lexical Complexity from Document-Level Distributions
arxiv-2404-01196.description: Abstract Existing methods for complexity estimation are typically developed for entire documents. This limitation in scope makes them inapplicable for shorter pieces of text, such as health assessment tools. These typically consist of lists of independent sentences, all of which are too short for existing methods to apply.

arxiv-2407-17156.title: Path Following and Stabilisation of a Bicycle Model using a Reinforcement Learning Approach
arxiv-2407-17156.creator: Sebastian Weyrer a , Peter Manzl a , A. L. Schwab b , Johannes Gerstmayr a ∗ \ast
arxiv-2407-17156.description: Abstract Over the years, complex control approaches have been developed to control the motion of a bicycle. Reinforcement Learning (RL), a branch of machine learning, promises easy deployment of so-called agents. Deployed agents are increasingly considered as an alternative to controllers for mechanical systems.

arxiv-2504-11484.title: The Coase Theorem and Ideal Exchanges
arxiv-2504-11484.creator: Daniel Lü
arxiv-2504-11484.description: Abstract . This paper offers a proof of the Coase theorem by formalizing the notion of ideal exchanges . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 91B02, 03E75, 03A10, 91-03. 1. Introduction An externality can be defined as an effect, often negative, that is imposed on a third party through a private activity.

pmc-11318240.title: Targeting AGTPBP1 inhibits pancreatic cancer progression via regulating microtubules and ERK signaling pathway
pmc-11318240.creator: Ding-zhong Li, Zhe-yu Yang, Asi leng, Qian Zhang, Xiao-dong Zhang, Yan-chao Bian, Rui Xiao, Jian-jun Ren
pmc-11318240.description: BackgroundAGTPBP1 is a cytosolic carboxypeptidase that cleaves poly-glutamic acids from the C terminus or side chains of α/β tubulins. Although its dysregulated expression has been linked to the development of non-small cell lung cancer, the specific roles and mechanisms of AGTPBP1 in pancreatic cancer (PC) have yet to be fully understood.

pmc-11530860.title: The role of cholesterol crystals and ocular crystal emboli in retinal pathology
pmc-11530860.creator: Nicholas G. Medawar, Tim F. Dorweiler, George S. Abela, Julia V. Busik, Maria B. Grant
pmc-11530860.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cholesterol crystals (CC) can be responsible for a range of clinical syndromes in the retina from asymptomatic plaques to retinal artery occlusion with clinical trials providing evidence for the efficacy in lipid lowering therapies in preventing ocular pathology. Much of the literature has focused on CC in retinal circulation as a marker of poor systemic health and have attempted to use them to categorize risk of mortality and stroke.

pmc-11581420.title: A Dual Action Platinum(IV) Complex with Self‐assembly Property Inhibits Prostate Cancer through Mitochondrial Stress Pathway
pmc-11581420.creator: Muhammad Nafees, Muhammad Hanif, Raja Muhammad Asif Khan, Faisal Faiz, Piaoping Yang
pmc-11581420.description: Platinum(IV) prodrugs are highly promising anticancer agents because they can selectively target tumors and minimize the adverse effects associated with their PtII congeners. In this study, we synthesized dual action PtIV complexes by linking oxoplatin with lithocholic acid. The synthesized compounds, designated as PL‐I, PL‐II, and PL‐III, can spontaneously self‐assemble in water, resulting in the formation of spherical shape nanoparticles.

pmc-11592789.title: Efficiency of IL-6 in Early Prognosis and Follow-Up in Critically Ill Patients with Septic Shock
pmc-11592789.creator: Yenifer Gamarra-Morales, Jorge Molina-López, Felipe-Carlos Santiago-Ruiz, Lourdes Herrera-Quintana, Héctor Vázquez-Lorente, Félix Gascón-Luna, Elena Planells
pmc-11592789.description: Background/Objectives: The aim of this study was to investigate the response of interleukin-6 (IL-6) during the first few hours of a patient’s stay in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) in a sample of critically ill patients with septic shock, compared to healthy subjects as controls.

pmc-11605915.title: Clinical profile of dilated cardiomyopathy in children enrolled in chronic cardiac care: a decade review in a sub-Saharan African tertiary center
pmc-11605915.creator: Henock Gashaw, Henok Tadele
pmc-11605915.description: BackgroundDilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a myocardial disease characterized by a dilated left ventricle (LV) and reduced LV systolic function. The clinical profile of DCM is not well studied in Africa with no reports from Ethiopia. This study aimed to describe the clinical profile of DCM and the factors associated with its clinical outcome in a tertiary center.

pmc-11692861.title: VETERAN AND FAMILY PERSPECTIVES OF THE VA NURSING HOME TO HOME PROGRAM
pmc-11692861.creator: Leah Haverhals, Chelsea Manheim, Rachel Fix
pmc-11692861.description: Veterans meeting United States (US) Veterans Health Administration (VA) service-connected disability requirements are eligible for VA provided nursing home (NH) care, resulting in high utilization. In 2023, the VA launched the Nursing Home to Home (NHTH) pilot program at three VA Medical Centers.

pmc-12372290.title: Oxidative stress in cancer: from tumor and microenvironment remodeling to therapeutic frontiers
pmc-12372290.creator: Xisong Liang, Jiadi Weng, Zhongyi You, Yang Wang, Jie Wen, Zhiwei Xia, Shaorong Huang, Peng Luo, Quan Cheng
pmc-12372290.description: Oxidative stress is a pathological condition of redox signaling dysregulation and macromolecular oxidative damage arising from elevated ROS levels. Oxidative stress interacts with tumor cell growth regulation and tumor microenvironment remodeling, and has been a critical hallmark of cancer. Targeting oxidative stress has garnered great attention in cancer therapy development.

pmc-12573790.title: Pore Network Percolation in Polymers of Intrinsic Microporosity Examined by Gaseous and Antimatter Probes
pmc-12573790.creator: Darin Sukalingum, Tianran Zhai, Marc H. Weber, Sohraab A. Khan, Thant H. Htut, Jeremy I. Feldblyum
pmc-12573790.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Synthesis of polymers with tailored properties requires an understanding of the underlying phenomena leading to these properties. Polymers of intrinsic microporosity (PIMs) are non-network polymers with a substantial guest-accessible free volume. Their BET surface areas have been reported to be as high as 1000 m2/g, and their porosity has led to the demonstration of some of the best membrane-based gas separations to date.

pmc-12630026.title: Efficient trace reconstruction in DNA storage systems using bidirectional beam search
pmc-12630026.creator: Zhenhao Gu, Hongyi Xin, Puru Sharma, Gary Yipeng Goh, Limsoon Wong, Niranjan Nagarajan
pmc-12630026.description: SummaryAs DNA data storage gains popularity, efficient trace reconstruction algorithms are crucial for fast decoding of data from noisy sequenced reads (or “traces”). Existing approaches, often adaptations of multiple sequence alignment or read correction methods, rely on strict assumptions of fixed error rates, showing limited generalizability to more complex datasets and with slower running times.

pmc-12821246.title: Genetic alterations and aberrant hormonal pathways in thymic epithelial tumors
pmc-12821246.creator: Yuqi Zhang, Wenxin Lian, Wenyan Zuo, Fufeng Wang, Yaru Zhang, Jing He, Yan Wang, Wen Gao

pmc-13320472.title: Beyond text: Using network centralities and AI models to detect suicide risk on Reddit
pmc-13320472.creator: Golnaz Nikmehr, Aritz Bilbao-Jayo, Aitor Almeida
pmc-13320472.description: Highlights•Presents an exploratory pilot-scale analysis of Reddit network centralities for suicide risk detection.•Shows structural features may provide preliminary predictive value independent of textual content.•Compares ML and GNN models using graph and text embeddings.•Finds centralities reveal patterns of isolation and influence.•Highlights both the promise and methodological limitations of network-based mental health monitoring.

pmc-13402734.title: Craton-margin lithosphere drives rare earth element ore-forming carbonatite magmatism
pmc-13402734.creator: Chunfei Chen, Yu Wang, Svyatoslav S Shcheka, Michael W Förster, Weicheng Jiang, Yanjing Chen, Stephen F Foley, Dorrit E Jacob, Yongsheng Liu
pmc-13402734.description: The majority of light rare earth element (LREE) resources are derived from carbonatite-associated deposits at cratonic margins. However, the origin of ore-forming carbonatite magmas remains unclear. Here, we conducted high pressure-temperature experiments to investigate LREE behavior during carbonate-rich sediment recycling.

pmc-13478502.title: Dynamic immune profiling predicts response to radiation plus anti-PD-1 therapy in oligometastatic renal cell carcinoma
pmc-13478502.creator: Van To, Niko Thio, Rebecca Castle, Sean Macdonald, Tristan Molden-Hauer, James Wells, Ryan McMahon, Mathias Bressel, Ben Tran, Arun A. Azad, Daniel Moon, Sree Appu, Lih-Ming Wong, Declan G. Murphy, Katharine Cuff, David Pryor, Lavinia Spain, Lewis Au, Criselle D’Souza, Paul J. Neeson, Shankar Siva
pmc-13478502.description: Biomarkers that predict response to combined radiation and anti-PD-1 therapy in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) are poorly defined. RAPPORT trial (NCT02855203) is a prospective phase I/II study of stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy (SABR) and pembrolizumab in 30 patients with oligometastatic ccRCC.
